evidence.text: SCHEME NAME: Post-Matric Scholarship for SC students

implementing_authority.value: Ministry Of Social Justice and Empowerment

evidence.text: IMPLEMENTING AUTHORITY: Ministry Of Social Justice and Empowerment

target_beneficiaries.value: Scheduled Caste (SC) students, especially those from the poorest households

evidence.text: aims to increase the Gross Enrolment Ratio of SC students in higher education, especially those from the poorest households
enabling them to continue and complete their education at the post-matriculation or post-secondary level
The ceiling on age limit for admission as a regular student in different classes should be decided by the concerned institutions.

income_criteria.value: Parents' or guardians' income from all sources does not exceed ₹ 2,50,000/- per annum

evidence.text: Scholarships will be paid to students whose parents' or guardians' income from all sources does not exceed ₹ 2,50,000/- per annum.

academic_criteria.value: Passed Matriculation, Higher Secondary, or a higher examination of a recognized university or Board of Secondary Education

evidence.text: Only candidates who belong to Scheduled Castes and have passed the Matriculation, Higher Secondary, or a higher examination of a recognized university or Board of Secondary Education are eligible.
Only candidates who belong to Scheduled Castes

domicile_criteria.value: Resident/domiciled in the State/UT to which the applicant actually belongs

evidence.text: the State/UT in which permanently settled or domiciled, as per the terms of domicile decided by the State
providing financial assistance to students from economically weaker families

benefit_amount.value: Annual allowances ranging from ₹ 2,500 to ₹ 13,000 depending on course group (I-IV) and status (Hosteller/Day Scholar); 10% extra for Divyang students

evidence.text: Category Of Courses Hostellers (Yearly) Day Scholars ( Yearly) Group-1 Degree and post Graduate Level professional courses ₹ 13,000/- ₹ 7,000/-
Ten percent extra allowances shall be provided for Divyang students.

application_method.value: Online through the National Scholarship Portal (NSP)

evidence.text: Applicant must register them self on NSP portal.
This is applicable to all the students who are currently beneficiaries of the scheme as well as fresh admissions.

required_documents.value: Photograph, Academic Certificate, Caste Certificate, Income proof, Domicile Certificate, Bank Account Details, Aadhaar Card

evidence.text: 1. Photograph. 2. Academic Certificate. 3. Caste Certificate. 4. Income proof. 5. Domicile Certificate. 6. Bank Account Details. 7. Aadhaar Card.
